retrievalProfile.description: A wide-angle mountain landscape featuring a central, vibrant neon-green handwritten message overlaid on the dark peaks.
triggerTerms: neon green handwritten text on mountains
excludeWhen: bright sunny day landscapes are requested

recipe.visualDefinition: A panoramic view of snow-capped jagged mountains under a cloudy, overcast sky, with a dark foreground plain and a bright neon-green scrawled message centered over the peaks.
coreVisualRelationships: Neon green text contrasts sharply against dark blue and grey mountain shadows
The horizontal horizon line divides the dark foreground from the textured mountain range
The central text placement anchors the composition amidst the chaotic mountain peaks
The soft, diffused sky light balances the harsh, saturated color of the lettering
coreInvariants: Neon green color for the central text

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The mountain range occupies the middle third of the frame; the text is centered horizontally and vertically over the peaks.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The vibrant neon-green text serves as the primary focal point.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye starts at the bright text, moves outward to the mountain peaks, and then settles on the dark foreground and cloudy sky.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: The dark foreground and the expansive cloudy sky provide significant negative space that frames the central action.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep blues and greys of the mountain shadows and foreground.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: White and light grey of the snow and clouds.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Vibrant neon green for the handwritten text.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation and medium-to-dark values in the background contrast with the high saturation and high value of the text.
paletteRestrictions: Avoid warm tones like red or orange
Keep the landscape palette cool and desaturated

letterConstructionRules: Variable stroke width mimicking a digital stylus or marker
Loose, disconnected characters with occasional ligatures
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single-style handwritten scrawl to maintain a raw, personal aesthetic.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the raw, unpolished look of the original scrawl.
Captures the jittery, electronic feel of the lettering.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a wide-angle, low-saturation photograph of a jagged, snow-capped mountain range under a cloudy, overcast sky at dusk. The foreground should be a dark, textured plain.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Using a neon green digital brush, hand-write the desired text in a messy, three-line centered stack over the middle of the mountain peaks.

verificationChecks: Is the handwriting messy and informal?
Are the mountains dark and snow-capped?

mustRedesign: Do not use standard fonts; must be hand-drawn
Do not use bright, sunny lighting for the landscape

mustAchieve: High contrast between text and background

postGenerationChecks: Ensure text is legible but looks authentically hand-scrawled
Check that the neon green doesn't bleed excessively into the background
Verify the horizon line is straight and low in the frame
recipe.reuseFormula: Take a desaturated, moody mountain landscape and overlay a centered, three-line neon green handwritten message to create a raw, expressive visual.
